description: This file defines a custom exception class 'FinancialActivityAccountNotFoundException' used to signal that a Financial Activity account with a specific ID or type was not found. It extends an abstract exception class and provides multiple constructors for different scenarios.

classes.name: FinancialActivityAccountNotFoundException
classes.description: A RuntimeException thrown when a Financial Activity account is not found based on ID or financial activity type.

methods.name: FinancialActivityAccountNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating the account with the given ID does not exist.

methods.name: FinancialActivityAccountNotFoundException(Long id, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and a cause when a data access exception occurs.

methods.name: FinancialActivityAccountNotFoundException(Integer financialActivityType)
methods.description: Constructor for cases when a financial activity type ID does not correspond to an existing account.
